title: Add dev script with tsx watch mode
description: Install tsx as a devDependency and configure a dev script that runs the CLI entry point in watch mode. This enables fast iteration during development without a full tsc build step for every change.
acceptanceCriteria: tsx is installed as a devDependency
dev script in package.json is 'tsx watch bin/rocket.ts'
npm run dev -- --help prints CLI usage without errors

steps.details: Run: `npm install --save-dev tsx`. tsx is a TypeScript executor that runs .ts files directly without compilation.
Set scripts.dev in package.json to: 'tsx watch bin/rocket.ts'. The watch flag re-runs the file automatically when it or its dependencies change.
Run `npm run dev -- --help`. The -- passes arguments through to the script. Should print the CLI help text. If src/cli.ts isn't implemented yet, create a minimal stub first.

technicalNotes: tsx uses esbuild internally for fast TypeScript transpilation — it does not do type-checking
Use 'npm run dev -- <args>' to pass arguments to the CLI during development
